create_lyft_infos: create pkl info files for the Lyft dataset from raw data with lidar and camera sweeps
fill_trainval_infos: generate training and validation info dicts from Lyft dataset samples including lidar paths and camera calibrations
export_2d_annotation: export 2D bounding box annotations from Lyft info files into COCO JSON format
review_lyft_categories: review the tuple of 9 Lyft dataset object categories used for detection tasks
refactor_fill_trainval_infos: refactor the internal _fill_trainval_infos function to support custom sweep limits or additional sensor types
